table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Region = UPPER(R.RemarKs),
	Area = R.Name,
	Town = B.Description,
	DistributorCode = LTRIM(RTRIM(:as_distcode + SPACE(100))),
	ShipToCode = LTRIM(RTRIM(:as_distcode + SPACE(100))),
	DistributorName = dbo.Fn_GetPreference('AppName'),
	CurrentYear=STR(Year(:adt_startdate), 4),
	CurrentMonth=STR(Month(:adt_startdate), 2),
	CustomerCode= A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	OutLetAddress = CASE WHEN C.Address1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE C.Address1 END + 
		CASE WHEN C.Address2 IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE C.Address2 END,
	GTM = 'Shared',
	DistributorChannelDescription = CC.Name,
	OutLetTypeDescription = CC.Name,
	TSE_TSM = R.Manager,
	DSRCode=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SManCode))),
	DSRName=(SELECT S.Name FROM SalesMan S WHERE S.SalesManCode=SL.SManCode),
	BrickId = SA.SubAreaCode,
	BrickName = SA.Name,
	Brand = B.Name,
	ArticleNumber=LTRIM(RTRIM(LTRIM(RTRIM(I.CustomICode)))),
	SKUName = I.Name,
	InvoiceNo = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SaleInvCode, 10))),
	InvoiceDate=Convert(varchar(10), SL.DATE, 104),
	Quantity=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SD.LooseQty, 12))),
	DBPrice=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(I.PurPrice, 12, 2))),
	TP = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SD.SalePrice, 12, 2))),
	DBValue=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(I.PurPrice * SD.LooseQty, 12, 2))),
	TPValue= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SD.SalePrice * SD.LooseQty, 12, 2))),
	ToDiscPerc = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SD.DiscPerc, 12, 2))),
	ToDiscDBValue=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ROUND(I.PurPrice * SD.LooseQty * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01, 2), 12, 2))),
	TODiscTPValue=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ROUND(SD.SalePrice * SD.LooseQty * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01, 2), 12, 2)))
FROM
	SaleLedger SL,
	SaleDetail SD,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	CustomerCategory CC,
	Area AR,
	SubArea SA,
	Region R,
	Item I,
	ItemBrand B
WHERE
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.POSTED = 'Y' AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.IBrandCode = B.IBrandCode AND
	I.ManfCode = :ai_manfcode AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND 
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
 	C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode AND
	C.SubAreaCode = SA.SubAreaCode AND
	SA.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode AND
	AR.RegionCode = R.RegionCode AND
	SL.DATE BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Region = UPPER(R.RemarKs),
	Area = R.Name,
	Town = B.Description,
	DistributorCode = LTRIM(RTRIM(:as_distcode + SPACE(100))),
	ShipToCode = LTRIM(RTRIM(:as_distcode + SPACE(100))),
	DistributorName = dbo.Fn_GetPreference('AppName'),
	CurrentYear=STR(Year(:adt_startdate), 4),
	CurrentMonth=STR(Month(:adt_startdate), 2),
	CustomerCode= A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	OutLetAddress = CASE WHEN C.Address1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE C.Address1 END + 
		CASE WHEN C.Address2 IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE C.Address2 END,
	GTM = 'Shared',
	DistributorChannelDescription = CC.Name,
	OutLetTypeDescription = CC.Name,
	TSE_TSM = R.Manager,
	DSRCode= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SManCode))),
	DSRName=(SELECT S.Name FROM SalesMan S WHERE S.SalesManCode=SL.SManCode),
	BrickId = SA.SubAreaCode,
	BrickName = SA.Name,
	Brand = B.Name,
	ArticleNumber=LTRIM(RTRIM(LTRIM(RTRIM(I.CustomICode)))),
	SKUName = I.Name,
	InvoiceNo = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SRInvCode, 10))),
	InvoiceDate=Convert(varchar(10), SL.DATE, 104),
	Quantity=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR( - SD.LooseQty, 12))),
	DBPrice=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(I.PurPrice, 12, 2))),
	TP = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SD.SRPrice, 12, 2))),
	DBValue=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR( - (I.PurPrice * SD.LooseQty), 12, 2))),
	TPValue= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(- (SD.SRPrice * SD.LooseQty), 12, 2))),
	ToDiscPerc = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SD.DiscPerc, 12, 2))),
	ToDiscDBValue=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(- 1 * ROUND(I.PurPrice * SD.LooseQty * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01, 2), 12, 2))),
	TODiscTPValue=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(- 1 * ROUND(SD.SRPrice * SD.LooseQty * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01, 2), 12, 2)))
FROM
	SRLedger SL,
	SRDetail SD,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	CustomerCategory CC,
	Area AR,
	SubArea SA,
	Region R,
	Item I,
	ItemBrand B
WHERE
	SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
	SL.POSTED = 'Y' AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.IBrandCode = B.IBrandCode AND
	I.ManfCode = :ai_manfcode AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND 
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
 	C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode AND
	C.SubAreaCode = SA.SubAreaCode AND
	SA.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode AND
	AR.RegionCode = R.RegionCode AND
	SL.DATE BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate
